approach: Add a pure check in a new module crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs, in the style of divergence::reconcile (divergence.rs:55). `check(&[Explanation]) -> Vec<Gap>` returns one MissingEvidence gap per absent Prompt, Code or Run source, and a NoOwnRecords gap for the Athena instance (ASCII case-insensitive) when no Record source is present. A source counts only when non-blank. The module doc and the spec measure state two limits: Record presence stands in for 'primary', and a mechanism with no explanation at all is not detected. Register the module in lib.rs between `manage` and `method_experiment`. Add crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs, modelled on study_instance_split.rs. It has behavior tests, a real-spec-entry test, and negative spec tests. Fill mechanism, owner and measure of OLY-B-S4-01 in docs/spec.toml, with the measure ending `status: not shown`. Add the one-line unit to xtask/shard-timings.txt, which a test requires. Add a CHANGELOG bullet and append one decision to docs/decisions.md, taking the next free id.

decisions.choice: A pure function over typed explanation records, not a check of studies/ files.
decisions.reason: No Athena study exists (only studies/firstmate-work-handling). A pure function can be tested now and wired in later, as S3-02's reconcile was. The measure honestly ends `status: not shown`.

rejected.option: Validate studies/<id>/ claim files in athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs
rejected.why: The brief puts the study capability out of scope, and no Athena instance exists to check.

rejected.option: Add a new record type for explanations
rejected.why: It would touch check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test for no gain; the requirement needs only a check.

decisions.choice: Evidence kinds are an enum (Prompt, Code, Run, Record). Every explanation needs Prompt, Code and Run; an Athena explanation also needs at least one Record. Blank sources do not count. The module doc and the spec measure state two limits: Record presence stands in for 'primary' (it does not weigh how much of the evidence is records), and a mechanism with no explanation at all is not detected, because check(&[]) is empty.
decisions.reason: This mirrors the accepted reading, which defines the rule as presence of each kind (answers finding 3). Stating the limits keeps the measure from suggesting more than it checks, in line with `status: not shown`.

rejected.option: Add an expected-mechanism list per instance and a Gap::Unexplained
rejected.why: It widens the reading the user accepted and needs an input no code supplies yet; the limit is stated instead.

rejected.option: Record evidence replaces the run requirement for Athena
rejected.why: The requirement says records are primary, not the only evidence.
Records belong to Athena only; a non-Athena instance without records must not be flagged.

decisions.choice: Gaps are an enum Gap { MissingEvidence{instance, mechanism, kind}, NoOwnRecords{instance, mechanism} }, returned in explanation order, then Prompt, Code, Run, then the records gap.
decisions.reason: Tests assert the exact gap; nothing is merged or dropped, as in reconcile.

rejected.option: Return a bool or a string list
rejected.why: Criterion 3 needs each test to assert the specific gap.

decisions.choice: Keep the xtask/shard-timings.txt line even though it is not in the reading's deliverables (answers finding 1).
decisions.reason: xtask/tests/ci_shards.rs:411-421 asserts the timed units equal the workspace's test units, so a new tests/ file without a line fails `cargo test` (criterion 5). It is a data file with no policy content, not a governance file. The S3-02 change did the same (HISTORY.txt, c9fb473). The line goes after shard-timings.txt:59.

rejected.option: Put the test inside src/ as a unit test to avoid a new test unit
rejected.why: The brief and criterion 3 name `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`, which needs a tests/ file.

decisions.choice: The decision entry takes the next id after the last `## D<n>` heading in the producer's base (D176 at this snapshot), appended at the end (answers finding 5).
decisions.reason: Rule::DecisionEntries (mirrors.rs:74, 143, 1054) requires a new entry to take the next id, and docs/decisions.md is append-only (mirrors.rs:265). Appending shifts no line, so the line-keyed backtest links (crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs:117-149) keep matching. The entry uses no supersede or amend wording.

rejected.option: Hardcode D176 regardless of the base
rejected.why: A parallel job landing first would make the entry fail the next-id rule.

steps: Create crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs. Write the module doc (OLY-B-S4-01; pure, reads and runs nothing; limits: Record presence stands in for 'primary', mechanisms with no explanation are not detected, no real Athena study feeds it yet). Define EvidenceKind {Prompt, Code, Run, Record}, Evidence {kind, source}, Explanation {instance, mechanism, evidence}, Gap::{MissingEvidence{instance, mechanism, kind}, NoOwnRecords{instance, mechanism}} and a const ATHENA_INSTANCE = "athena". A kind is present when some evidence has that kind and a source that is non-blank after trimming. Add doc comments on every public item.

Implement `pub fn check(explanations: &[Explanation]) -> Vec<Gap>`: for each explanation in order, push MissingEvidence for each of Prompt, Code, Run that is absent, then push NoOwnRecords when the instance equals `athena` (eq_ignore_ascii_case) and no Record evidence is present.

In crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs add `pub mod mechanism_explanation;` between `pub mod manage;` (line 128) and `pub mod method_experiment;` (line 129), and a doc bullet beside the divergence bullet near line 45.

Create crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs. Add helpers ev(kind, source) and explanation(instance, mechanism, evidence). Add the behavior tests listed under criterion 3. Add the spec tests under criteria 1 and 4, copying owner_problem, measure_label_problem and real_requirement from study_instance_split.rs with REQUIREMENT `OLY-B-S4-01` and TEST_COMMAND `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation`. The real-spec test asserts that the mechanism contains both new file paths and `check`, and that the measure states the limits. Add doc comments naming the requirement and its limits.

Edit docs/spec.toml, OLY-B-S4-01 only (about line 2992): mechanism = the `check` function in crates/athena-core/src/mechanism_explanation.rs, which flags a mechanism explanation lacking a prompt, code or observed-run source, or, for Athena, a source from its own records, tested by crates/athena-core/tests/mechanism_explanation.rs; owner stays `Athena`; measure = the test file checks complete and defective explanations and this entry; Record presence stands in for 'primary' and mechanisms with no explanation are not detected; `check` is not yet run on a real Athena study; then `cargo test -p athena-core --test mechanism_explanation; status: not shown`. Use a basic string with no embedded double quotes.
Add `athena-core --test mechanism_explanation 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt after the `athena-core --test divergence 5.00` line (59).

Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet first under `### Added` in [Unreleased]. Read the last `## D<n>` heading in docs/decisions.md and append the entry with the next id (D176 in this snapshot) in the D175 format (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance). Add no supersede or amend wording and edit no existing entry. Do not touch records/.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. Fix any failure in the new or edited files.
